pokedexEntries.rb: A team of DIGLETT triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

pokedexEntries.ye: A team of triplets that can burrow over 60 MPH. Due to this, some people think it’s an earthquake.

pokedexEntries.go: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.

pokedexEntries.si: Extremely powerful, they can DIG through even the hardest ground to a depth of over 60 miles.

pokedexEntries.cr: These DIGLETT triplets dig over 60 miles below sea level. No one knows what it’s like underground.

pokedexEntries.rs: DUGTRIO are actually triplets that emerged from one body. As a result, each triplet thinks exactly like the other two triplets. They work cooperatively to burrow endlessly.

pokedexEntries.fr: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

pokedexEntries.lg: A team of DIGLETT triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

pokedexEntries.em: Because the triplets originally split from one body, they think exactly alike. They work cooperatively to burrow endlessly through the ground.

pokedexEntries.dpp: Its three heads move alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.

pokedexEntries.hg: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.

pokedexEntries.ss: Extremely powerful, they can dig through even the hardest ground to a depth of over 60 miles.

pokedexEntries.bw: Its three heads move alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Its three heads move alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.

pokedexEntries.x: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

pokedexEntries.y: Extremely powerful, they can dig through even the hardest ground to a depth of over 60 miles.

pokedexEntries.oras: Dugtrio are actually triplets that emerged from one body. As a result, each triplet thinks exactly like the other two triplets. They work cooperatively to burrow endlessly.

pokedexEntries.su: This set of triplets moves cooperatively. It’s the power of teamwork that enables this Pokémon to dig to a depth of 60 miles.

pokedexEntries.mo: Despite the closeness between this Pokémon and farmers and other people, no one has ever seen the parts of it concealed underground.

pokedexEntries.us: While the three of them normally get along splendidly, on rare occasions a huge fight will break out over which head gets to eat first.

pokedexEntries.um: Dugtrio’s heads are sleek and smooth and incredibly hard. It can dig through any soil with its headbutts.

pokedexEntries.lgpe: A team of triplets that can burrow to a depth of 60 miles. It’s reported that this triggers an earthquake.

pokedexEntries.sw: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

pokedexEntries.sh: These Diglett triplets dig over 60 miles below sea level. No one knows what it’s like underground.
